flows.name: Opening an image in Photo
flows.description: File > Open with a PNG, JPEG or HEIC: the window reads the file, PhotoModel decodes it into the canvas, and the window notes it in recents and draws it.

steps.label: File > Open runs the open panel; the person picks a PNG, JPEG or HEIC, and the window reads its bytes and pixel size

steps.note: A .ora Photo Document takes the archive path instead: it decodes off the main actor, then PhotoModel's openDocument.

steps.label: decodes through the codec the window passed in, capped at Photo's open size
lays the decoded RGBA8 pixels into the canvas PixelBuffer
the window reads the new canvas and the document name
notes the file in Open Recent and the suite's shared recents
draws the canvas picture through RenderDispatcher
